title: Pass the navigation timing type when populating a history entry

labels.name: topic: navigation
labels.description: Navigating documents, the Location interface, window.open() and fragment navigation

body: Pass the computed navigation timing type before the source snapshot parameters when populating a reloaded or traversed history entry. The caller already selects `back_forward` when the target entry has no document and `reload` otherwise. This passes the selected value in the position required by the history-entry population algorithm.
